description: "Addresses by Henry Drummond" by Henry Drummond is a collection of motivational speeches written during the late 19th century. The book primarily explores the theme of love, drawing from biblical teachings, particularly the 13th chapter of 1 Corinthians, where love is depicted as the greatest virtue.
